name: Harwood's Spurfowl
rangeDescription: Highlands of central ethiopia
description: A dark, medium-sized francolin with a large patch of red bare skin around the eyes, and a red bill and legs. The blackish feathers of the back, neck, and underparts have pale fringes.

name: Bounty Islands Shag
rangeDescription: Bounty islands (new zealand)
description: A large pink-footed marine shag endemic to the Bounty Islands and surrounding coastal seas. Adults are black above with a blue sheen, white below, with white patches on upper wings visible in flight.

name: Guianan Warbling-Antbird
rangeDescription: Eastern venezuela (northeastern bolívar) to the guianas and northeastern amazonian brazil
description: Small antbird; most easily identified by conspicuously striped head, contrasting tawny flanks, and sluggish behavior. Most common in disturbed and secondary forests, at forest edges, and near treefall gaps.

name: Tawny Tit-Spinetail
rangeDescription: Locally in andes of central and southeastern peru, bolivia, and northwestern argentina (jujuy, salta)
description: Small, bright cinnamon bird with a long tail. Found at high elevations in pockets of short Polylepis forests and scrub, usually surrounded by grasslands or barren rock.

name: Maghreb Owl
rangeDescription: Morocco, algeria, and tunisia
description: Learn about Tawny Owl (Maghreb): explore photos, sounds, and observations collected by birders around the world.

name: Gray Kestrel
rangeDescription: Savanna and woodland of sub-saharan africa
description: Medium-sized gray falcon with bright yellow eye-ring and base of the bill. Quite plain, but does show barring on the wings in flight.

name: Kilombero Weaver
rangeDescription: Southeastern tanzania (floodplain of kilombero river)
description: A fairly small and slim weaver with a relatively slender bill. Breeding male is distinctive, with bright yellow overall plumage and a black-and-chestnut bib.

name: Northern Grosbeak-Canary
rangeDescription: Southern ethiopia and somalia to northern kenya; isolated population in taita hills
description: A large seedeater with a very large pinkish bill. Males are brownish-olive above and yellow below with a diffuse but noticeable head pattern; females are brown above and white below with heavy streaking all over the body.

name: Yapacana Antbird
rangeDescription: Locally in eastern colombia, southwestern venezuela, and northwestern brazil (amazonas)
description: Odd, slender antbird with a rather long bill. Males are gray above and white below with white spots on the wings; females have rusty underparts and lack wing spots.

name: Chuuk Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Chuuk (western caroline islands)
description: A species of forest and forest edge habitats on Micronesia’s Chuuk Islands. Combination of bluish-gray head, pale orange throat and breast, brown-tinged wings, and slightly peaked head is unique on the islands.

name: White-eared Bronze-Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Montane forest of new guinea including batanta (raja ampat islands, off western new guinea)
description: A small cuckoo of foothill and mid-montane forest. Underparts white with dark bars from bill to tail.

name: Green-and-white Hummingbird
rangeDescription: East slope of andes of peru (southern huánuco to southern puno)
description: Medium-sized hummingbird of middle elevations. Green above, white below, with a variably pinkish lower mandible.

name: Arabian Golden Sparrow
rangeDescription: Southwestern arabian peninsula (southwestern saudi arabia and western yemen; djibouti and northwestern somalia)
description: A small, unusual sparrow of dry country. Males are mostly yellow with black-and-white wings and tail.

name: Fiji Goshawk
rangeDescription: Fiji
description: A small goshawk with pale grayish-blue wings and head and a peachy reddish collar, chest, and belly. Note the piercing orange eye and orange legs.

name: Taiwan Bamboo-Partridge
rangeDescription: Taiwan
description: Medium-sized, mostly brownish terrestrial bird with a slate-gray head and neck, dark orange throat, and rusty spots on sides and wings. Endemic to Taiwan., where it inhabits lowland and foothill forests with undergrowth and densely vegetated edges, where difficult to see.

name: Makatea Fruit-Dove
rangeDescription: Makatea island (western tuamotu archipelago)
description: A relatively slender fruit-dove that appears mostly green with a greenish belly, a silver chest and head, a magenta forehead, and an orange bill. Similar to Atoll Fruit-Dove, but much more boldly colored, with dark instead of pink legs.

name: Pink-throated Twinspot
rangeDescription: Northeastern south africa (limpopo southward to kwazulu-natal), eastern eswatini, and southern mozambique (south of the save river)
description: A delicate, rotund waxbill with a pink uppertail and a white-spotted belly. The male has a guava-pink face and throat and a brown crown, while the female has mostly gray underparts.

name: Bannerman's Shearwater
rangeDescription: Breeds bonin and volcano islands (off japan)
description: A small black-and-white shearwater with relatively broad wings and a long rounded tail. Underwing very white, contrasting with darker smudgy marks along the leading edge of the wing.

name: Yellow-billed Loon
rangeDescription: Northern eurasia and northern north america; winters to northern baja california
description: A large, heavy-billed loon of the High Arctic. Much like a Common Loon but with a thicker neck and blockier head.

name: Black-thighed Falconet
rangeDescription: Forest of myanmar to malay peninsula and greater sundas
description: Dwarfed by shrikes and thrushes, this tiny raptor looks almost parakeet-like as it perches on exposed branches. Coloration distinctive: birds are black above with a white chest and rusty orange belly.
